==English== ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|:inh|enm:demayne>>|tree=+}} From {{inh|en|enm|demayne}}, {{m|enm|demain||rule}}, from {{der|en|fro|demeine}}, {{m|fro|demaine}}, {{m|fro|demeigne}}, {{m|fro|domaine||power}}, ({{cog|fr|domaine}}), from {{der|en|la|dominium||property, right of ownership}}, from {{m|la|dominus||master, proprietor, owner}}. {{doublet|en|demesne|dominium}}, and closely related to {{m|en|dominion}} and {{m|en|domino}}. See also {{m|en|dame}}, and compare {{m|en|demain}}, {{m|en|danger}}, {{m|en|dungeon}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˌdəʊˈmeɪ̯n/|/dəˈmeɪ̯n/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌdoʊ̯ˈmeɪ̯n/|/dəˈmeɪ̯n/|a=GA,CA}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌdoʊ̯ˈmeɪ̯n/|[dəʊ̯ˈmeɪ̯n]|a=California|a2=California Vowel Shift}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-domain.ogg|IPA=[dəʊ̯ˈmɛ̽ɪ̯n]}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌdəʉ̯ˈmæ̝ɪ̯n/|/dəˈmæ̝ɪ̯n/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ɖoˈmeːn/|a=South Asia}} * {{rhymes|en|eɪn|s=2}} * {{hyph|en|do|main}} * {{hmp|en|demesne}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # A [[geographic]] area [[own]]ed or [[controlled]] by a single [[person]] or [[organization]]. #: {{ux|en|The king ruled his '''domain''' harshly.}} #* {{RQ:Guardian|date=25 February 2020|url=https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2020/feb/25/the-end-of-farming-rewilding-intensive-agriculture-food-safety|author=Christopher de Bellaigue|title=The end of farming?|passage=Farmers account for just 1.5% of the British population, but the size of their '''domain''' – 71% of the country’s surface area is classified as farmland – has given them power over the public imagination.}} #* {{quote-song|en|lyricist={{w|Nergal (musician)|Nergal}}, {{w|Tomasz Wróblewski}}|composer={{w|Behemoth (band)|Behemoth}}||title=Ov My Herculean Exile|album={{w|Opvs Contra Natvram}}|artist={{w|Behemoth (band)|Behemoth}}|year=2022|passage=A blinded hermit in oblivion, disgraced
Like Odysseus lost in Poseidon's endless '''domain'''
In a realm devoid ov solace, I roam}} # A [[field]] or [[sphere of influence|sphere]] of [[activity]], [[influence]] or [[expertise]]. #: {{ux|en|Dealing with complaints isn't really my '''domain''': get in touch with customer services.}} #: {{ux|en|His '''domain''' is English history.}} # A [[group]] of [[related]] [[item]]s, [[topic]]s, or [[subject]]s. # {{lb|en|mathematics|set theory}} The set of [[input]] ([[argument]]) values for which a [[function]] is defined. ## {{lb|en|more generally|of a [[binary relation]] R between A and B}} The set ''A''; The [[subset]] of ''A'' consisting of [[element]]s ''a'' of ''A'' such that there exists an element ''b'' in ''B'' with ''(a,b)'' in ''R''. # {{lb|en|mathematics}} A {{l|en|ring}} with no [[zero divisor]]s; that is, in which no {{l|en|product}} of nonzero elements is zero. #: {{hyponyms|en|integral domain}} # {{lb|en|mathematics|topology|analysis}} An open and connected set in some [[topology]]. For example, the interval (0,1) as a subset of the [[real number]]s. # {{senseid|en|any DNS domain name}} {{lb|en|computing|Internet}} Any [[Domain Name System|DNS]] [[domain name]], particularly one which has been [[delegate|delegated]] and has become representative of the delegated domain name and its [[subdomain]]s. # {{lb|en|computing|Internet}} A collection of [[Domain Name System|DNS]] or DNS-like [[domain name|domain names]] consisting of a [[delegate|delegated]] [[domain name]] and all its [[subdomain]]s. # {{lb|en|computing}} A collection of information having to do with a domain, the [[computer]]s named in the domain, and the [[network]] on which the computers named in the domain reside. # {{lb|en|computing}} The collection of computers identified by a domain's [[domain name]]s. # {{lb|en|physics}} A small region of a magnetic material with a consistent magnetization direction. # {{lb|en|computing}} Such a region used as a data storage element in a [[bubble memory]]. # {{lb|en|data processing}} A form of technical [[metadata]] that represent the type of a data item, its characteristics, name, and usage. #* {{quote-web|en|year=a. 2013|author=IBM|title=IBM Terminology - terms D| site='IBM Software{{!}}Globalization{{!}}Terminology'| url=https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/ecm/10.1.0?topic=objects-data-domains| accessdate=2013-12-29| passage=A characteristic of a field. A data domain specifies a data type and applies the minimum and maximum values allowed and other constraints.}} # {{lb|en|taxonomy}} The highest [[rank]] in the classification of [[organism]]s, above [[kingdom]]; in the three-domain system, one of the [[taxon|taxa]] {{taxfmt|Bacteria|kingdom}}, {{taxfmt|Archaea|kingdom}}, or {{taxfmt|Eukaryota|superkingdom}}. # {{lb|en|biochemistry}} A [[folded]] section of a [[protein]] [[molecule]] that has a [[discrete]] [[function]]; the equivalent section of a [[chromosome]]. # {{lb|en|geology}} An area of more or less [[uniform]] [[mineralization]].
